text: The dataset that detected the 2021 tree-cover loss is the Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC) version GFC-2025-v1.13. This dataset mapped approximately 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss within the asset during 2021. The detection was corroborated by the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The loss primarily occurred in planted forest areas, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda.
